field_missing: field '{field}' missing (neither in the host nor in the group)
group_no_local: a group cannot use Local access nor the local admin credential
id_permanent: ID is permanent and cannot be edited
id_permanent_hostname: ID is permanent; edit only the hostname
legacy_inventory: legacy inventory: run the ID migration before editing
local_created_by_installer: the Local host is created by the installer (scripts/engine/localadmin/cli.py ensure-host)
local_cred_only_local: the local admin credential can only be used by the Local host
local_instance_only_local: local_instance only exists on the Local host
local_needs_cred: the Local host needs the CRED_LOCAL_ADMIN credential and the local_instance link
local_not_deletable: the Local host (this server) is protected and cannot be deleted; to disable local root use: sudo scripts/engine/localadmin/provision.py disable
local_protected: protected Local host: access, credential, IP and link cannot be changed (use provision.py)
one_local_host: only one host can have access.method=local
rev_required_map: inventory revision required when creating from the map
runs_on_cycle: cycle in 'runs on' (one host hosts the other and vice versa)
runs_on_self: a host cannot run on itself
